name: Fennec Dash
category: CRM • ERP • CMS • MAP • PIM — All-in-One Business Platform
description: Fennec Dash is a self-hosted business platform with 21 integrated modules covering CRM, ERP, HR, finance, logistics and marketing. Built on PHP 8 and MySQL, it is designed for Algerian compliance, priced in DZD, and available in English, French and Arabic.

primary.name: Fennec Purple
primary.use: Primary actions, links, table headers, active navigation

primaryHover.use: Hover and pressed state of primary

primaryDarkUi.use: Dark-mode primary for icons, borders and large type only

accent.name: Fennec Gold
accent.use: Accent, badges, highlights, focus moments; one CTA at most

goldDark.use: Gold-toned text on white — large only

logoGold.use: Lockup artwork only, never a UI token

display.use: Landing page, decks, ads, trade-show panels, document covers
display.never: Below 14px, inside a table, or in a form

text.use: Admin screens, forms, tables, modals, client portal, email

mark.use: Specimen only, not a master file

logos.ink: Logo gold #FAC259, Fennec purple #6B21A8, ink #231F20 (or white reversed)
rules: Use the supplied file at its supplied proportions on an approved background.
Never rebuild, recolor or set the lockup in type.
No vector master exists; do not scale beyond 110mm in print.
Second person, active voice; subject is the customer or the software.
One claim per sentence; prefer a number to an adjective.
Marketing sentences under 20 words; one CTA per section.
Never apologise for the market: Law 18-07, DZD, Arabic and French are features.

toneBySurface.marketing: Benefit, then proof. No unverified metrics.
toneBySurface.productUi: The next action. Instructional, no personality, no jokes.
toneBySurface.errors: What happened, never blame the user, always state the fix.
toneBySurface.support: First person, named agent, specific next step and time.
toneBySurface.sales: Scope and numbers. No urgency theatre or fake scarcity.

conditional: 100+ active companies — only with a dated source and a named reviewer

rules: One purple primary button per view or card.
Never set body copy in gold (#F9BC3B is 1.71:1 on white).
No hex value outside this guide; tints come from rgba() at 4, 8, 10, 15 or 20%.
8px spacing grid; one shadow per surface; soft edges.
Components consume tokens, never raw hex.
